name: genomicschain_regwatch
description: Regulatory and standards watch for GenomicsChain and KairosChain. gc_regwatch_scan fetches each watched source, compares a normalised digest against the recorded baseline, and counts down the dated triggers; gc_regwatch_report renders the watchlist and the findings as a bilingual (en/ja) standalone HTML report. Fetches and compares only — it never judges whether a change is material, because the party that produced a finding must not also be the party that rules on it.
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
